heading.purpose: The largest text in the app — empty-state titles only. There is no hero.

title.purpose: App title and panel titles; the ceiling for everyday chrome.

label.purpose: Uppercase, tracked, faint section eyebrows in the sidebar and controls panel.

body.purpose: Descriptions, notes, and help text at a generous line-height.

mono.purpose: Component names, prop keys, live values, event expressions, generated code.

shadows.name: seated
shadows.purpose: Active mode-switch segment and small raised buttons — barely off the surface.

shadows.name: dropdown
shadows.purpose: Menus and popovers opening over content.

shadows.name: floating-card
shadows.purpose: A lifted panel; two layers for a soft ambient cast.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Modal dialogs, decisively above everything else.

shadows.name: switch-knob
shadows.purpose: The toggle handle, so it reads as a real object riding its track.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: The accent-soft halo around a focused field, paired with an accent border.

motion.name: transition-state
motion.purpose: The default hover/active state change on buttons, items, and controls.

motion.name: transition-switch
motion.purpose: Toggle track color and knob translation.

motion.name: overlay-entrance
motion.purpose: The Add-block dialog and command menu settle in — rise and scale from 0.985 — while the scrim fades over 0.15s. Reduced motion keeps the fade only.

motion.name: undo-rise
motion.purpose: The undo toast rises into place after a removal; reduced motion fades it instead.

motion.name: reach-count
motion.purpose: The reach readout's counts roll to their new figure when a toggle changes the theme's reach; reduced motion snaps.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The default outline button — the tool has almost no filled buttons.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid #d3d8de; border-radius: 6px; background: #ffffff; color: #6b7280; font-size: 12px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.1s ease, color 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #fbfbfc; color: #17191c; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f46e5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The outlined field with the system's signature accent-soft focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 220px; height: 32px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid #d3d8de; border-radius: 6px; background: #ffffff; color: #17191c; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #4f46e5; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #eef2ff; }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: A pill track with a shadowed knob, built on a visually-hidden real checkbox (shown checked).
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch-input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); border: 0; } .ds-switch-track { display: block; width: 40px; height: 23px; border-radius: 999px; background: #cbd2da; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-switch-knob { display: block; width: 17px; height: 17px; margin: 3px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.3); transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-switch-input:checked + .ds-switch-track { background: #4f46e5; } .ds-switch-input:checked + .ds-switch-track .ds-switch-knob { transform: translateX(17px); } .ds-switch-input:focus-visible + .ds-switch-track { outline: 2px solid #4f46e5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item (active)
components.description: The accent-soft selection idiom — the tool's universal 'this is selected' language.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; width: 200px; padding: 8px 10px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #6b7280; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.1s ease, color 0.1s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #fbfbfc; color: #17191c; } .ds-nav-name { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 13px; } .ds-nav-meta { font-size: 11px; color: #6b7280; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-nav-item-active, .ds-nav-item-active:hover { background: #eef2ff; color: #4f46e5; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item-active .ds-nav-meta { color: #4f46e5; }

components.name: Mode Switch (segmented)
components.description: The header's Component/Compose toggle; the active segment lifts on a seated shadow.
components.css: .ds-modes { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; background: #fbfbfc; border: 1px solid #e3e6ea; border-radius: 7px; } .ds-mode { padding: 4px 13px; border: none; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: #6b7280; font-size: 12px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.1s ease, color 0.1s ease; } .ds-mode:hover { color: #17191c; } .ds-mode-active, .ds-mode-active:hover { background: #ffffff; color: #17191c; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.08); }

components.name: Color Field
components.description: A swatch beside a mono hex field; unset colors read as dashed and dimmed.
components.css: .ds-color { display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: 40px 160px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-swatch { width: 40px; height: 32px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid #d3d8de; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-hex { width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid #d3d8de; border-radius: 6px; background: #ffffff; color: #17191c; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; } .ds-hex:focus { border-color: #4f46e5; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #eef2ff; }

components.name: Command menu
components.description: The ⌘K palette — a keyboard-first modal that jumps to any component or runs an action, on the same idiom as the Add-block dialog.
components.html: Components
components.css: .ds-cmd { width: 320px; border: 1px solid #e3e6ea; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(15,23,42,0.24); overflow: hidden; } .ds-cmd-search { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 9px 12px; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #e3e6ea; background: #fbfbfc; font: 13.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-cmd-list { padding: 6px 8px; } .ds-cmd-cat { padding: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6b7280; } .ds-cmd-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; padding: 7px 10px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #6b7280; cursor: pointer; } .ds-cmd-row-active, .ds-cmd-row:hover { background: #eef2ff; color: #4f46e5; } .ds-cmd-name { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; } .ds-cmd-hint { font-size: 11px; color: #6b7280; } .ds-cmd-row-active .ds-cmd-hint { color: #4f46e5; }

narrative.overview: The Component Playground is a workbench, not a showroom. Tools are laid out cleanly along the edges — a sidebar of components, a controls panel, a theme rig, a code readout — and the work itself is clamped in the middle, lit evenly, with nothing around it competing for the eye. The chrome is quiet on purpose: its entire job is to hold whatever component you are examining and get out of its way. Every surface is a neutral gray or white; the one spot of color is a single indigo that marks what is yours — the selected item, the focused field, the active mode. The personality is precise, dense, and unshowy: type is small and half-pixel-tuned, identifiers wear a monospace face because they are code, numbers are tabular, corners are gently rounded, borders are hairline, and depth is almost absent. It reads like a well-kept instrument: calm, legible, and confident enough not to decorate.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral grayscale chrome with a single indigo accent — the preview is the only color that matters.
Monospace for every identifier (component names, prop names, values, code).
Flat surfaces divided by hairline borders; shadow reserved for true elevation.
Compact, half-pixel typography (10.5–14px working range) and tabular numerals.
Gentle 6px corners, understated motion (0.1s ease for state, a 0.18s decelerate for things that arrive), one universal focus ring.

rules.name: The Neutral Chrome Rule
rules.body: The workbench is grayscale plus one indigo. New tool UI introduces no competing color; emphasis uses the indigo or the indigo wash, never a new hue. The previewed components and their themes are the only real color on screen.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo marks selection, focus, and the active choice — nothing else. Keep it on well under ~10% of any screen; if everything is accented, nothing is.

rules.name: The Status-Isn't-Brand Rule
rules.body: Red/green/amber mean success and failure. Never repaint a status color in the brand indigo, and never use the brand indigo to signal an error.

rules.name: The Mono Identifier Rule
rules.body: If a string is code — a component name, a prop key, a value, a handler expression — it is set in the monospace face. Prose about the code is set in sans. The two faces tell you what is literal.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every number that sits in a list or repeats down a column uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, so counts never shift as they change.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces are flat and border-separated. A shadow appears only in response to elevation (a menu, a dialog, a lifted tab) — never to decorate a static panel.

dos: Do keep new chrome grayscale + the single indigo. Reach for accent (emphasis) or accent-soft (selected/active ground) before any new color.
Do set every identifier — component names, prop keys, values, code — in the monospace face, and everything about them in sans.
Do mark selection and focus with the established idioms: accent-soft background + accent text for active items, and the 0 0 0 3px accent-soft ring on focused fields.
Do separate resting surfaces with 1px border lines and the panel/panel-alt/page value steps — reserve shadow for things that truly lift.
Do use tabular-nums for any count, and keep uppercase eyebrows small (10.5–11px), tracked (+0.07em), and text-faint.
Do stay dense and compact: 6px workhorse radius, quick 0.1s ease transitions, half-pixel type sizes where the existing scale uses them.
donts: Don't introduce a second brand hue or paint chrome with the previewed components' theme colors. The chrome is the frame, not the picture.
Don't use mark-violet (#8b5cf6) anywhere but the logo mark's gradient, and don't repaint status red/green/amber in the accent (or vice versa).
Don't drop shadows on static panels, or replace the hairline-border separation with elevation.
Don't enlarge the type into a marketing hierarchy — there is no hero; 16px is the ceiling.

Don't proliferate breakpoints or fork the IA. The chrome has exactly one width breakpoint (900px: grid to one-at-a-time tabs) plus input-method (pointer: coarse) sizing on top — nothing more. The desktop pane grid is the home; make new chrome work there first, let it become one of the mobile tabs below the breakpoint, and never build a second, different mobile information architecture.
Don't let the accent spread past selection/focus/active — if it's on more than a sliver of the screen, it has stopped meaning anything.
